comment: The two Apple Encrypted Archives of iPadOS 27.2.1 (24B156) for iPad12,1 / iPad12,2, and the
APFS volumes inside them, read from the restore image itself.
dmg_sha256 is the digest of the .aea CONTAINER as it sits in the IPSW (compressed and
encrypted). The volume UUIDs come from the APFS volume superblock, which only exists after
the archive has been decrypted with the key from its own com.apple.wkms.fcs-key-url;
The raw image digests in board.toml [root] are a different thing again: they cover the
expanded image, not this container. Both are recorded because a wrapper change moves one and

trust_cache_bundle.format: u32 version, u32 static_offset, u32 total, then the two IM4P payloads
